sentences.text: This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.124/2024 dated 21.02.2024 registered at Police Station, Kolar Road, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376, 376(A), 376)3), 376(2)(N) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2 . It is contended by the counsel for applicant that the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. reflects that she herself called the applicant and they were is relation ship.
It is contended by the counsel that in MLC report, there is no external injury in the body and even no definite opinion has been expressed by the medical experts regarding commission of offence.

It is contended that as the charge-sheet has been filed the applicant is no more required for custodial interrogation, hence,
the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that the offence was committed with the minor, therefore no case for grant of bail is made out.

sentences.text: 5. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

6. Considering the totality of the circumstances coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 05-06-2024 and the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. which reflects that the victim herself has called the applicant and on 20/02/2204 went along with the applicant to Kajrikheda on her own volition.
Charge-sheet has been filed, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
